title: Cinema Mode: 3D AI Attack Chain Visualization for ai_loop Runs
goal: Cinema Mode currently shows a static 3D node graph of tasks and findings. For ai_loop runs it must evolve into a live attack chain visualization: each loop iteration spawns a new node in the 3D graph connected to the previous, the node color and shape indicates what was found (critical finding = red pulsing sphere, XSS = orange, SQLi = red, auth bypass = purple), and a thread connects finding nodes to the follow-up tool node showing the pivot chain. The narration panel must show the AI's current hypothesis and what it is trying to exploit. For standard runs Cinema Mode behavior remains unchanged.
generation_reason: Cinema Mode does not show the AI reasoning chain. For ai_loop runs the 3D visualization should make it visually obvious that the AI is chaining exploits — finding XSS, extracting a session, testing authenticated surfaces. This is the showpiece visualization.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.no_breaking_changes: Standard run Cinema Mode must remain identical.
constraints.performance: The 3D scene must not drop below 30fps for up to 50 nodes. Use instanced meshes or LOD if needed.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Keep implementation bounded to this task package. Defer broader scanner, exploit-chain, UI, or runtime work to separately queued packages.

implementation_notes.chain_nodes: Each loop iteration proposal creates a chain node. Connect sequential nodes with animated Line. Pivot nodes branch off from finding nodes.
implementation_notes.node_types: tool_node (cyan sphere), finding_node (severity-colored pulsing sphere), pivot_node (orange diamond/octahedron), hypothesis_node (wireframe).
implementation_notes.narration: Narration panel text = current loop iteration hypothesis from the last AgentReasoning record.
implementation_notes.detection: Check run.configuration_json?.run_mode === 'ai_loop' to switch visualization mode.
implementation_notes.data_source: Loop proposals from getRunAiInsights() proposals array. Each proposal has reasoning_text, proposed_tool, proposed_target, status.

acceptance_criteria: For ai_loop run: Cinema Mode shows chain nodes connecting tool runs to findings to follow-up tools.
Finding nodes pulse with severity color.
Pivot nodes branch from finding nodes with a colored thread.
For standard run: Cinema Mode looks identical to before this task.
